<mxfile host="Electron" pages="5" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="RegistrarLote" id="ZMsMUlmr3khu9GQLDAJY"> <mxGraphModel dx="5050" dy="3004" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "---
title: Registrar lote - paso por las capas del backend
---
sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 participant F as Front
 participant C as Controller<br>infrastructure/input
 participant A as Adapter<br>application/input
 participant UC as UseCase<br>application/usecases
 participant D as Dominio<br>domain
 participant R as Repositorios + Outbox<br>infrastructure/output
 participant RL as OutboxRelay<br>infrastructure/output
 participant MQ as RabbitMQ
 participant Q as QR Service<br>handler, adapter, usecase

 Note over F,C: Login OIDC con WorkOS, POST /me y POST /farms siguen el mismo recorrido de capas
 F->>C: POST /api/lots (cookie de sesión)
 C->>C: RequireActor resuelve el actor
 C->>A: Execute(request.CreateLot)
 A->>A: Assembler: DTO a borrador de Lot
 A->>UC: Execute(borrador)
 UC->>R: ActorActive y FarmExists (puertos de salida)
 R-->>UC: actor y finca
 UC->>UC: Authorizer: acción create_lot
 UC->>D: lot.New(finca, código, variedad, proceso, cosecha)
 D-->>UC: lote válido en etapa finca
 UC->>R: ExistsByCode
 Note over UC,R: TxManager.WithinTx: una sola transacción
 UC->>R: Save lot
 UC->>R: Publish lot.created (fila en outbox)
 UC-->>A: Lot
 A-->>C: DTO de respuesta
 C-->>F: 201 lote
 opt validación, permiso o código repetido
 UC-->>C: exception tipada (por Adapter)
 C-->>F: ErrorResponder: 400 / 403 / 404 / 409
 end
 RL->>R: Leer outbox pendiente (SKIP LOCKED)
 RL->>MQ: lot.created
 RL->>R: Marcar published_at
 MQ->>Q: lot.created
 Q->>Q: Handler, Adapter, ProjectLotCreated
 Q->>Q: Inbox processed_event y guardar lot_view",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"

dx="3214" dy="1911" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "---
title: Registrar etapa - paso por las capas del backend
---
sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 participant F as Front
 participant C as Controller<br>infrastructure/input
 participant A as Adapter<br>application/input
 participant UC as UseCase<br>application/usecases
 participant D as Dominio<br>domain
 participant R as Repositorios + Outbox<br>infrastructure/output
 participant RL as OutboxRelay<br>infrastructure/output
 participant MQ as RabbitMQ
 participant Q as QR Service<br>handler, adapter, usecase

 F->>C: POST /api/lots/:id/events (If-Match)
 C->>C: RequireActor resuelve el actor
 C->>A: Execute(request.RegisterStage)
 A->>A: Assembler.ToCommand (versión y detalles de etapa)
 A->>UC: Execute(Command)
 UC->>R: ActorActive y LotExists
 R-->>UC: actor y lote
 UC->>UC: Authorizer: acción register_stage
 UC->>UC: LotVersion: If-Match igual a la versión
 alt versión distinta
 UC-->>A: exception
 A-->>C: error
 C-->>F: 412 / 409 (ErrorResponder)
 else versión coincide
 Note over UC,R: TxManager.WithinTx: una sola transacción
 UC->>R: FindLast (último evento)
 R-->>UC: evento previo
 UC->>D: lot.AdvanceTo(etapa) valida el orden
 D-->>UC: lote avanzado o error de etapa fuera de orden
 UC->>D: NewStageEvent con hash encadenado
 D-->>UC: evento de etapa
 UC->>R: UpdateStage (versión optimista)
 UC->>R: Save evento
 UC->>R: Publish lot.stage_registered (outbox)
 UC-->>A: Result
 A-->>C: DTO de respuesta
 C-->>F: 201 etapa registrada + ETag
 end
 RL->>R: Leer outbox pendiente
 RL->>MQ: lot.stage_registered
 MQ->>Q: lot.stage_registered
 Q->>Q: Handler, Adapter, ProjectLotStage
 Q->>Q: Actualizar lot_view si la versión es mayor",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"

 "data": "---
title: Subir evidencia - capas de traceability (por construir)
---
sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 participant F as Front
 participant C as Controller<br>infrastructure/input
 participant A as Adapter<br>application/input
 participant UC as UseCase<br>application/usecases
 participant D as Dominio<br>domain/evidence
 participant G as Garage<br>infrastructure/output/external
 participant R as Repositorios + Outbox<br>infrastructure/output
 participant RL as OutboxRelay<br>infrastructure/output
 participant MQ as RabbitMQ

 F->>C: POST /api/lots/:id/evidences (imagen)
 C->>C: RequireActor y límite de tamaño
 C->>A: Execute(request.UploadEvidence)
 A->>A: Assembler: DTO a Command
 A->>UC: Execute(Command)
 UC->>R: ActorActive y LotExists
 R-->>UC: actor y lote
 UC->>UC: Authorizer: acción upload_evidence
 UC->>D: evidence.New en estado pending (solo imágenes)
 D-->>UC: evidencia válida
 UC->>G: PUT en evidence-quarantine (puerto de almacenamiento)

<mxGraphModel dx="1698" dy="333" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "---
title: Procesar evidencia - capas de processor y consumidores (por construir)
---
sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 participant MQ as RabbitMQ
 participant H as Handler + Adapter<br>processor
 participant UC as UseCase<br>ProcessEvidence
 participant D as Dominio<br>imagen
 participant G as Garage
 participant T as Traceability<br>handler, adapter, usecase
 participant N as Notifications<br>handler, adapter, usecase
 participant Q as QR Service<br>handler, adapter, usecase

 MQ->>H: evidence.uploaded (processor.events)
 H->>H: Decodificar envelope y armar el request
 H->>UC: Execute(Command)
 UC->>UC: Inbox: processed_event por message_id
 UC->>G: Leer archivo de evidence-quarantine
 UC->>D: Validar imagen (JPEG o PNG, tamaño, magic bytes)
 UC->>D: SHA-256, miniatura y limpiar EXIF
 alt imagen válida
 UC->>G: Mover a bucket evidence
 UC->>MQ: evidence.processed
 else imagen inválida
 UC->>MQ: evidence.rejected con motivo
 end
 par Traceability
 MQ->>T: evidence.processed o rejected
 T->>T: Pasar la evidencia a su estado final
 and Notifications
 MQ->>N: evidence.processed o rejected
 N->>N: Enviar correo con Resend (circuit breaker)
 N->>N: Guardar notification_log
 and QR
 MQ->>Q: evidence.processed
 Q->>Q: Actualizar evidence_view
 end",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"

<mxGraphModel dx="3074" dy="659" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "---
title: Consultar QR - paso por las capas del servicio QR
---
sequenceDiagram
 autonumber
 actor C as Consumidor
 participant TR as Traefik
 participant F as Front
 participant K as Controller<br>infrastructure/input
 participant A as Adapter<br>application/input
 participant UC as UseCase<br>application/usecases
 participant D as Dominio<br>redirect, scan, lotview
 participant RD as Redis<br>LotViewCache
 participant DB as Repositorios<br>Postgres

 C->>TR: Escanea el QR (/l/:lot_id)
 TR->>K: GET /l/:lot_id
 K->>A: Execute(request.ResolveScan)
 A->>UC: Execute(path)
 UC->>DB: RedirectRepository.ListActive
 UC->>D: rule.Matches y rule.Resolve(path)
 D-->>UC: Resolution con lot_id
 UC->>RD: LotViewExists: buscar en caché
 alt cache miss
 UC->>DB: LotViewRepository.FindByID
 UC->>RD: Guardar en caché
 end
 UC->>DB: ScanRepository.Save (qr_scan, sin bloquear)
 UC-->>A: Resolution
 A-->>K: DTO ScanRedirect
 K-->>TR: 301 Location (no-store)
 TR-->>C: Redirección
 C->>F: Abrir página del lote
 F->>TR: GET /api/public/lots/:lot_id
 TR->>K: GET /public/lots/:lot_id (sin /api)
 K->>A: Execute(request.GetPublicLot)
 A->>UC: Execute(lot_id)
 UC->>RD: LotViewExists: buscar en caché
 alt cache hit
 RD-->>UC: LotView
 else cache miss
 UC->>DB: LotViewRepository.FindByID
 DB-->>UC: LotView
 UC->>RD: Guardar en caché
 end
 UC-->>A: LotView
 A->>A: lotviewmapper: LotView a DTO
 A-->>K: PublicLot
 K-->>F: 200 JSON del lote
 F-->>C: Mostrar trazabilidad",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
